verdict: Yes, as a craft-led brand. ALittle Extra from Guwahati pitched handmade fabric jewellery on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Fabric jewellery is light, low-cost to make and uses waste textiles, which appeals to buyers looking for sustainable accessories.
angle: Earrings, necklaces and bangles made from handloom scraps and embroidery offer a unique look. Material costs are low and there's little risk of metal price swings. Each piece is handmade, so train a team early.
